authority.center_thesis: Programmable chemical worlds make experimental agency measurable.
authority.interpretation: This map is an isolated story input. It does not edit or supersede the manuscript, figure manifest, derived-data layer, evidence DAG, experiment ledger, or release manifest.

state_vocabulary.frozen_publication_evidence: Immutable, reviewed evidence may support the bounded wording now, subject to final Work I integration.
state_vocabulary.completed_descriptive_evidence: Completed audited evidence supports only the stated descriptive unit and boundary.
state_vocabulary.completed_development_only: Completed evidence may motivate or illustrate but may not be promoted to a confirmatory or population claim.
state_vocabulary.review_pending_not_publication_claim: Artifact exists but its Work I claim remains in REVIEW; report only the review-state fact and bounded technical result.
state_vocabulary.pending_implementation: No scientific result exists; wording is protocol- or future-tense only.
state_vocabulary.boundary_only: This row constrains language and does not introduce a positive empirical result.
state_vocabulary.external_release_blocked: Scientific input may exist, but release readiness is false until the named external or integration gate closes.

claims.allowed_wording: Programmable chemical worlds make experimental agency measurable: ChemWorld combines executable experimental contracts, controlled single-component world forks, a known-policy positive control, and auditable complete-system trajectories.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not describe the title thesis as a universal theorem, a scalar intelligence score, evidence of general agent superiority, or validation in a physical laboratory.
claims.analysis_unit: apparatus-level triangulation across independently audited contracts and certificates; not a pooled statistical sample
claims.figure_panel: Figure 1A-D overview; title is now eligible because F and V both passed

claims.allowed_wording: Lifecycle completion or an endpoint score does not uniquely specify the experimental policy or trajectory that produced it.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim that endpoint scores are useless, that every equal endpoint has a different policy, or that any observed trajectory difference identifies an internal mental state.
claims.analysis_unit: complete agent system by matched world-arm cell for terminal policy; fresh session-level arm pair within a selected world for trajectory contrasts
claims.manuscript_section: 1 Introduction; 6 Complete-system policies; 7-8 Process profiles; 9 Discussion

claims.allowed_wording: ChemWorld exposes 15 registered task contracts spanning 28 typed operation kinds and five instrument contracts; qualification executed 415 complete-experiment boundary recipes and bound all 62 task-specific metric endpoints to executable evaluators.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not say that autonomous agents were empirically evaluated on all 15 tasks, that 62 means 62 unique metric definitions, or that qualification proves agent competence.
claims.analysis_unit: registered task contract, globally unique operation/instrument kind, task-metric binding, or executed boundary recipe as specified by each count

claims.allowed_wording: A ChemWorld experiment is a stateful sequence of typed operations and measurements with explicit termination, final-assay, resource, failure, and evaluator contracts rather than a single value-returning query.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not call every operation physically realistic, treat declared instrument latency as wall-clock process time, or imply calibration to real laboratory devices.
claims.analysis_unit: typed operation or instrument contract under the executable qualification probe

claims.allowed_wording: All 28 operation kinds committed in valid contexts; invalid probes preserved physical state, and the five instrument probes matched declared cost, sample consumption, destructiveness, and terminal preconditions.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not equate state preservation after an invalid probe with zero cost or zero penalty, or infer real-world safety from simulated failure semantics.
claims.analysis_unit: 28 valid/invalid operation probe pairs and five instrument probes
claims.manuscript_section: 3.2 Identity, resources and replay; Methods 10.1 and 10.9

claims.allowed_wording: Accepted transitions, public observations, resource receipts, world identities, and evaluator outputs are content-bound and exactly replayable; fresh agent sessions are intentionally new decision trajectories, not token-sequence replay.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not say exact replay regenerates provider tokens or proves a language model is deterministic.
claims.analysis_unit: stored environment transition and resource event; session-level pair for fresh trajectories

claims.allowed_wording: ChemWorld constructs content-addressed single-private-component world forks while preserving all nine declared public-contract components.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not describe the certificate as arbitrary third-party DSL support, multi-component causal identification, or evidence that an agent learned the changed law.
claims.analysis_unit: parent-child world pair with one preregistered private component difference

claims.allowed_wording: Across two intervention classes and three seeds per class, all six parent-child pairs executed the same typed sequence, met preregistered physical and public-observation divergence, and replayed exactly, yielding 24 deterministic traces with zero provider calls.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not treat 24 traces as 24 independent agent trials or extrapolate beyond the two qualified intervention classes.
claims.analysis_unit: six parent-child pairs; trace count is execution accounting

claims.allowed_wording: The world-fork certificate establishes controlled programmability of the executable apparatus under a deterministic fixed-policy probe.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim agent adaptation, agent performance, physical-laboratory transfer, or a fully general world-authoring language.
claims.analysis_unit: certificate-level claim boundary

claims.allowed_wording: The experimental-agency profile is a multidimensional observable policy construct spanning terminal commitment, evidence acquisition, evidence-conditioned action, resource deployment, and outcome trajectory; endpoint context remains separate.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not collapse the axes into a scalar intelligence score or interpret operational readouts as latent mental states.
claims.analysis_unit: one campaign profile, equally weighted across ten world-arm campaigns per policy

claims.allowed_wording: In the frozen 5 world × 2 arm × 3 policy matrix, the profile recovered the prespecified signatures, nulls, six partial orderings, resource expectations, and matched-arm invariance for assay_all, start_then_discard, and measure_then_threshold.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not call the deterministic policies competitive baselines, rank them by endpoint quality, or infer a causal material-information null effect.
claims.analysis_unit: 30 primary campaign profiles and 180 closed primary lifecycles; lifecycle rows are not pooled before profile construction

claims.allowed_wording: All 12 frozen validity gates passed; the threshold policy expressed both branches, with 28 assays and 32 discards, and provider calls were zero.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not tune or reinterpret the frozen threshold from the formal five worlds, and do not treat lifecycle counts as independent inferential replicates.
claims.analysis_unit: frozen gate and campaign-level profile; threshold branch counts are census accounting

claims.allowed_wording: All 30 same-identity deterministic original/retest campaign pairs matched controller, trajectory identity, profile, and component hashes; retests are reliability evidence and are excluded from the primary estimand.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not interpret deterministic test-retest as variability across stochastic agents or as real-world external validity.
claims.analysis_unit: 30 same-identity deterministic campaign pairs, outside the primary estimand
claims.figure_panel: Figure 2D or Extended Data reliability panel

claims.allowed_wording: The known-policy experiment establishes a bounded construct/discriminant-validity positive control for this simulated apparatus.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim endpoint ranking, model/provider capability, scalar experimental intelligence, causal information effects, or physical-laboratory generalization.
claims.analysis_unit: bounded positive-control matrix

claims.allowed_wording: Two distinct complete agent systems each closed all 60 matched batch lifecycles across the same five worlds and two information arms.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not say the systems were independently configured in a way that implies model-only matching, or treat closure as task-quality equivalence.
claims.analysis_unit: complete agent system by matched world-arm cell; 10 cells per system

claims.allowed_wording: The 120 closed lifecycles comprised 84 final assays and 36 explicit discards: Codex assayed 60/60 and discarded 0, whereas DeepSeek assayed 24/60 and discarded 36.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not omit the 84-assay/36-discard decomposition, call a discard a failed or incomplete lifecycle, or infer that discard was economically optimal.
claims.analysis_unit: terminal decision census within each complete-system demonstration

claims.allowed_wording: Non-final instrument use was nearly identical (164 versus 163), while primitive-operation totals (815 versus 889) and terminal commitment differed, separating evidence acquisition from continued investment and terminal policy.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not infer equivalent evidence quality from instrument counts or attribute the differences to the model backend alone.
claims.analysis_unit: complete-system aggregate over ten matched cells

claims.allowed_wording: Within the DeepSeek system, nominal-information cells contained 16 assays and 14 discards versus eight assays and 22 discards under opaque codes, with 67 more operations; this is a descriptive five-world within-system profile.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not infer a population material-information effect or use this five-world profile as a cross-system ranking.
claims.analysis_unit: five paired worlds within one complete agent system

claims.allowed_wording: The cross-system result is an apparatus-portability and complete-system behavior-profile demonstration.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim a causal model-backend effect, because model, decision transport, provider retry behavior, source code, and scaffold differ.
claims.analysis_unit: complete agent system, not isolated model backend

claims.allowed_wording: Compiled controls comprise 29,580 nonduplicated simulator executions across two task families and provide low-authority calibration of task, information, prediction, calibration, and claim readouts.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not present 29,580 executions as independent samples or as autonomous primitive-control experiments.
claims.analysis_unit: paired physical world; execution count reports apparatus use

claims.allowed_wording: Nominal-minus-opaque mean endpoint differences were +0.0724 in electrochemical conversion and +0.0260 in reaction-to-crystallization across ten matched worlds per task, with task-specific descriptive intervals and interpretations.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not pool the tasks, claim a universal positive prior effect, or turn descriptive finite-world intervals into population coverage claims.
claims.analysis_unit: ten paired physical worlds per task and information contrast

claims.allowed_wording: The fixed misindexed prior changed early actions in both tasks, but neither task passed the frozen joint recovery rule; action correction and performance restoration must remain separate readouts.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not say the agent generally corrected misinformation or that a sampled score benefit proves successful belief revision.
claims.analysis_unit: ten paired worlds per task under one fixed misindexing intervention

claims.allowed_wording: Endpoint score, held-out directional accuracy, Brier calibration, structural/mechanistic declarations, and unsupported-claim rate form distinct reported coordinates rather than one competence score.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not infer that any one diagnostic causes another or synthesize an unregistered composite ranking.
claims.analysis_unit: task-arm summary across ten physical worlds, with each diagnostic kept separate

claims.allowed_wording: Classical optimizers are calibration controls within the compiled interface, not the paper's target competition.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not write an LLM-versus-BO leaderboard, claim G2 superiority over G0, or compare unmatched action authority as if it were a method-only intervention.
claims.analysis_unit: interface-specific calibration comparison

claims.allowed_wording: The five-world Codex development matrix made discovery position, retention, drawdown, recovery, terminal-to-best, instrument use, and resource deployment jointly observable and generated the process-profile hypotheses.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not promote the five single-trajectory arm averages to a confirmatory prior effect or use selected development examples as the fresh-session estimand.
claims.analysis_unit: one development campaign per world-arm cell; five paired worlds

claims.allowed_wording: Fresh-session replication used two deliberately selected physical worlds, five prespecified arm pairs per world, and 120 vessel opportunities; 18/20 cells completed, two were right-censored, 114 vessels were executed, and eight pairs were complete.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not hide the two right-censored pairs, count six unstarted slots as executed experiments, or generalize two selected worlds to a world population.
claims.analysis_unit: physical world by fresh trajectory replicate; complete matched arm pair for pairwise contrasts

claims.allowed_wording: Best-of-campaign and algebraically independent raw-terminal contrasts were sign-discordant in two of eight complete fresh-session pairs; their descriptive Pearson correlation was +0.826.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not substitute terminal-to-best for the independent raw-terminal diagnostic, infer a hypothesis-test result, or claim that endpoints usually reverse.
claims.analysis_unit: eight complete world-by-fresh-session arm pairs

claims.allowed_wording: Six of eight frozen world-by-core-lifecycle classifications were mixed at the registered 75% rule; this is a threshold-sensitive supporting classification, while continuous contrasts and right-censored rows remain primary displays.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not call 6/8 the primary conclusion, treat the eight classifications as independent inferential units, or omit that the sensitivity grid spans 2-8 mixed classifications.
claims.analysis_unit: eight descriptive world-by-core-metric classifications sharing trajectory outcomes

claims.allowed_wording: Within the two selected physical worlds, fresh agent sessions changed the observed process profiles; provider sampling seed was not controlled.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not identify the provider as the causal source of variation, claim variance dominance, or estimate a general material-information effect.
claims.analysis_unit: fresh session-level arm pair within each of two development-selected worlds

claims.allowed_wording: An outcome-blind contract has registered a finite-population evaluator-only audit of the 60 DeepSeek lifecycles (24 observed assays and 36 committed discards), with exactly 36 planned shadow terminal evaluations and fixed estimands, thresholds, denominators, censoring rules, and evidence-entry rules.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not state or imply any latent score, regret, false-discard rate, commitment precision, or terminal-quality conclusion before L05-L06 complete and pass review.
claims.analysis_unit: frozen 60-lifecycle census; 36 discard units and 10 campaign cells, with campaign_oracle_regret defined on the nine cells containing a discard
claims.manuscript_section: 9 Latent terminal audit placeholder; Methods protocol only
claims.figure_panel: Figure 3C placeholder only; no quantitative panel yet

claims.allowed_wording: The L02 audit reports that all 36 pre-discard checkpoints are deterministically reconstructable from frozen source bytes, prefixes, observations, resource receipts, and independent replay; it executed zero shadow terminals and accessed zero latent discard scores.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not equate reconstructability with terminal quality, claim comparison to a historically persisted hidden-state digest, or say the shadow branch has been executed.
claims.analysis_unit: 36 frozen pre-discard checkpoints across ten source trajectories
claims.manuscript_section: Methods qualification or Supplement only until independent review

claims.allowed_wording: Prefix-identity replay/terminal replacement (L03) and latent-terminal analysis (L04) are implementation tasks; formal 36-unit execution belongs only to L05 and reporting to L06.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not describe claimed branches, synthetic qualification, or protocol code as formal latent-terminal evidence, and do not access outcomes before the formal freeze.
claims.analysis_unit: none; implementation status only
claims.manuscript_section: No Results language; Methods placeholder may state the registered future pipeline

claims.allowed_wording: After L05-L06 only, the complete audit may report quality of discarded states, discard regret, false-discard fraction, assay commitment precision/recall, decision-time regret, sensitivities, and unresolved-outcome bounds under the frozen definitions.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Never say a shadow assay was chosen or observed by the agent, that discard saved real laboratory resources, that the system is generally rational or irrational, or that the audit ranks systems.
claims.analysis_unit: future finite-population discard lifecycle, assay lifecycle, and campaign-cell estimands exactly as frozen
claims.manuscript_section: Future 9 Latent terminal Results after L06
claims.figure_panel: Future Figure 3C-D after frozen L06 derived data

claims.allowed_wording: The registered platform surface and the paper's empirical evidence scope are distinct: compiled results cover two tasks and autonomous results one task.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not write that 15 registered tasks are 15 formal agent results or that the platform covers arbitrary chemistry.
claims.analysis_unit: scope statement

claims.allowed_wording: ChemWorld complements physical self-driving laboratories by enabling controlled, repeatable studies of agent decisions in selected synthetic chemical worlds.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim real-laboratory deployment, robot-operating ability, universal chemical fidelity, physical safety, or direct transfer.
claims.analysis_unit: scope statement

claims.allowed_wording: Work I studies the measurement apparatus and bounded behavioral profiles; large-scale mechanism adaptation, belief revision, model/backend ablation, and physical bridging remain separate work.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not recycle historical Gate A as current agent law learning or consume Work II mechanism-adaptation conclusions in this paper.
claims.analysis_unit: scope boundary

claims.allowed_wording: The current manuscript, display items, figure manifest, and legacy derived-data object are integration inputs rather than the final Work I release surface; publication readiness remains false pending L completion, Work I D03-D05 integration, final manuscript/figure review, the external G0 archive, and author metadata.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Do not call the current tree publication-ready, silently retain the old six-figure order as the Work I final architecture, or invent archive/author identifiers.
claims.analysis_unit: release/integration gate
claims.manuscript_section: Data and code availability; internal integration notes

integration_notes: The Work I six-figure order is Figure 1 apparatus/forks, Figure 2 known-policy validity, Figure 3 terminal policy plus latent audit, Figure 4 compiled controls, Figure 5 autonomous lifecycle/process profiles, and Figure 6 fresh trajectories.

The tracked paper/arxiv/figure-manifest.json still represents the pre-Work-I order and contains no world-fork, known-policy, or latent-terminal panel; P01-P09 and S02-S10 must reconcile it rather than treating this map as a manifest edit.
The tracked arxiv-v1-derived-data.json is frozen for the earlier manuscript but does not contain F/V/L Work I outputs; D03 must build the new single frozen layer before final quantitative figures.
L01 and L02 are REVIEW, L03 and L04 are CLAIMED, and L05-L06 are not complete. No latent terminal quality result is presently publishable.
Every cited path is repository-relative and must exist; every file_sha256 in source_registry is the current byte hash, while content hashes use the artifact's own declared hash semantics.
